title: The Red Heifer and the Water of Purification
description: The Lord gives Moses and Aaron the instruction to slaughter a flawless red cow outside the camp. The priest Eleazar sprinkles some of its blood seven times toward the tent of meeting, and the cow is burned together with cedar wood, hyssop, and crimson wool. The ashes are collected and kept to make water for cleansing. The law describes how anyone who has touched a human corpse, a bone, someone killed, or a grave becomes unclean for seven days, and must be cleansed by having a clean man sprinkle the cleansing water on them on the third and seventh days. Anyone who does not cleanse themselves shall be cut off from Israel [ref:4 Mos 19:1-22|4. Mosebok 19:1-22].
